description: This file defines the StreamingQuery trait in Apache Spark, which provides an interface for managing and monitoring streaming queries, including methods for retrieving query information, waiting for termination, stopping the query, and debugging.

classes.name: StreamingQuery
classes.description: A trait representing a handle to a continuously running streaming query in Spark, providing methods for query management, status retrieval, and debugging.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the user-defined name of the streaming query, or null if not specified.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Returns the persistent unique identifier of the query across restarts.

methods.name: runId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this specific run of the query.

methods.name: sparkSession
methods.description: Returns the SparkSession associated with this query.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Indicates whether the query is currently active and running.

methods.name: exception
methods.description: Returns an exception if the query was terminated due to an error.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Provides the current status of the query.

methods.name: recentProgress
methods.description: Returns recent progress updates for the query.

methods.name: lastProgress
methods.description: Returns the most recent progress update.

methods.name: awaitTermination
methods.description: Blocks until the query terminates, throwing an exception if terminated with an error.

methods.name: awaitTermination
methods.description: Blocks until the query terminates or the specified timeout elapses, returning true if terminated.

methods.name: processAllAvailable
methods.description: Blocks until all available data has been processed and committed.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the query execution, waiting for threads to terminate or timeout.

methods.name: explain
methods.description: Prints the physical plan for debugging.

methods.name: explain
methods.description: Prints the extended physical plan for debugging.
